test_policy.notes: The admissions FAQ states 'Farmingdale is now SAT/ACT optional'. Some programs still list scores: the admission chart gives SAT 1100 or ACT 22 for the Dental Hygiene entry-level BS.

requirements.notes: SUNY Application or Common App, $50 fee (the FAQ says fee waivers exist but also that a state campus cannot waive it; unresolved). Official high school transcript required; recommendation letters and a personal statement are highly recommended, not required. Coursework from outside the US needs a NACES credential evaluation ('applications lacking a NACES evaluation will not be reviewed'); international applicants also submit the SUNY autobiographical essay and passport copy. Applicants are typically notified about two weeks after all documents arrive.

deadlines.label: Fall application deadline, fall 2027 entry (domestic and international)
deadlines.notes: Fall June 1 and spring Nov. 1 (international page) / Jan. 3 (first-year page); no year is printed, so fall 2027 is assumed. Rolling admissions. The 2024-25 Common Data Set also lists a priority date of Jan. 3.

deadlines.label: Earlier deadline for Nursing and Professional Pilot (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Dates page: Nursing application and document deadline January 15 (TEAS by February 15); Professional Pilot application January 15, documents February 1; Dental Hygiene first priority January 15. No year is printed, so fall 2027 is assumed.

deadlines.label: Tuition deposit ($100)
deadlines.notes: Due May 1, or within 30 days of acceptance for students accepted after April 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: The only alternative listed is an official transcript from an accredited US college with C+ or better in a college-level writing course. Scores must be within two years before the application term. The SAT Evidence-Based Reading score of 400 is also listed as accepted proof.

english.notes: The How to Apply page lists 'TOEFL-IBT 74 or 4.0'.
The required-documents page (modified 10/21/26) says 110; the older How to Apply page says 105. 110 is recorded.

aid.notes: The How to Apply page states 'Financial aid and scholarships are not available to international students.' Proof of funds for the I-20: $40,000 if living on campus, $28,000 if living off campus with a local sponsor providing room and meals (Professional Pilot adds about $9,000/semester). SUNY-mandated health insurance applies to F-1/J-1 students. No ESL, conditional-admission or pathway program is described on the international pages.
